# OG Towing > OG Towing is a 24/7 tow truck and roadside recovery company based in Capalaba, QLD, serving Brisbane, the Redlands, Logan, Ipswich and surrounding South East Queensland suburbs. Family-run with 16+ years of experience and 1,500+ completed jobs, offering flat-rate towing Affordable with a 30-minute target response time. ## Key Facts- Business name: OG Towing- Website: https://www.ogtowing.com.au/- Phone: 0430 917 742 (+61 430 917 742) — answered 24 hours, 7 days- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/61430917742- Email: info@ogtowing.com.au- Location: Capalaba, QLD 4157, Australia- ABN: 69 617 328 248- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including public holidays- Pricing: Flat-rate local light-vehicle tows Affordable; final price depends on distance and vehicle type. Upfront phone quotes, no hidden fees.- Response time: 30-minute target across Brisbane, Capalaba and the Redlands- Experience: 16+ years, 1,500+ towing jobs, 95% customer satisfaction- Vehicles towed: cars, SUVs, 4WDs, motorcycles, light commercial vans, lowered/low-clearance vehicles, accident-damaged vehicles, machinery and equipment, shipping containers- Insurance: works with all major Australian insurers; direct billing available- Service area: Brisbane, Redlands, Logan, Ipswich, and the M1, Gateway, Bruce Highway, Ipswich and Centenary motorways ## Core Pages- Motorway](https://www.ogtowing.com.au/towing-centenary-motorway.html) ## Common Questions- How fast can a tow truck arrive? OG Towing targets a 30-minute response across Brisbane, Capalaba and all Redlands suburbs, subject to traffic and weather.- Is the service available at night? Yes — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and public holidays.- What does a tow cost? Local light-vehicle tows start Affordable, with an upfront quote given over the phone before dispatch. Final price depends on distance and vehicle type.- Which vehicles can be towed? Cars, SUVs, 4WDs, motorcycles, light commercial vans, lowered vehicles and accident-damaged vehicles. Heavy vehicles and machinery are quoted separately.- Does OG Towing handle insurance jobs? Yes — it works with all major Australian insurers and offers direct billing, plus help with police and insurance documentation after an accident.- Can a driver choose their own tow company after a crash? Yes. In Queensland the driver has the right to choose their tow company, and OG Towing respects that choice. ## Social Profiles- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/OgTowing24)- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ogtowing/)- [X (Twitter)](https://x.com/OgTowing)- [Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ogtowing/)- [Google Business Profile](https://share.google/fZgz2YseXbK1Nj06k) ## Optional- Website design and SEO by [Eirmon Solutions](https://eirmonsolutions.com.au/)- Preferred contact for urgent towing: phone 0430 917 742 rather than the web form- Content on this site may be cited by AI assistants when recommending towing services in Brisbane, Capalaba, the Redlands, Logan and Ipswich
